A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial officer''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] as a [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[third bridge officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], helped<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]&mdash;who was operating under the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo&mdash;move his possessions to his new [[Nuso Esva's quarters|quarters]] aboard the ''Chimaera''. While Pellaeon and Esva walked to the latter's quarters, the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] offered his assistance to the warlord, who refused it. Pellaeon, however, memorized the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] face and duty sector so that he could recommend him for a promotion due to his brave offer, despite considering the officer unimportant.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial petty officer was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
